finding_title: Unliquidated Cash Advances and Undelivered School Furniture
summary: Cash advances granted to Special Disbursing Officers totaling ₱2.4B remained unliquidated beyond statutory 30-day reporting deadlines. Deficiencies in warehouse logistics led to procurement of school desks stored in private exposed compounds.

finding_title: Delay in Infrastructure Project Implementations & Liquidated Damages
summary: Delayed implementation of 14 infrastructure projects aggregating ₱48.2M resulted in non-imposition of statutory liquidated damages against defaulting contractors contrary to RA 9184.
Disbursements totaling ₱460M funded under Confidential Expenses lacked timely intelligence liquidation receipts as mandated by COA-DBM-DILG-DND-JC No. 2015-01.

finding_title: Expired Medical Commodities & Inefficient Cold-Chain Inventory
summary: Inventory management issues led to near-expiry drugs and medical supplies valued at ₱7.43B stored in regional health warehouses without immediate redistribution to rural health units.

finding_title: Defective Flood-Control Pumping Stations in Camanava
summary: Technical inspection of 8 flood pumping stations showed sub-standard hydraulic pumps that broke down during monsoon season despite certificate of final inspection issued to contractor.
